summary: Verified fix for multilingual keywords bug (ES/FR/DE were showing empty keyword list on category screens). Tested all 5 languages (it, en, es, fr, de) on /category/immobili and all 8 categories in French. In every case, the keywords section renders 6 correctly translated items and the section title (t.keywordsTitle) matches the target locale (PALABRAS CLAVE:, MOTS-CLÉS :, SCHLÜSSELWÖRTER:, KEYWORDS:, PAROLE CHIAVE:). Language persistence via AsyncStorage confirmed: after selecting Español and reloading, /category/immobili still renders in Spanish. Static verification confirms all 8 categories × 5 language keys = 40 keyword sets defined in /app/frontend/src/constants/keywords.ts. Fallback chain (current lang → en → it → []) in [categoryId].tsx is correctly implemented.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean: keyword lookup uses fallback chain (lang → en → it → []) which is defensive and future-proof.
Recommendation (non-blocking): consider typing CATEGORY_KEYWORDS as Record<CategoryId, Record<LanguageCode, Keyword[]>> to get compile-time guarantees that every category has every language.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test flow: goto /settings → click [data-testid=lang-{code}] → goto /category/{categoryId} → assert [data-testid=keywords-title] text and count of [data-testid=keyword-N] elements (should be 6). Categories: immobili, bandi, auto_moto, gare_appalto, divertimento, finanza, nuove_leggi, lavoro. Languages: it/en/es/fr/de.
